title: "Not accepting new graduate students"
description: "As of August 2026, Diogo is not taking on new graduate students."

As of **August 2026**, Diogo is **not accepting new graduate students** for
the time being. Prospective students are welcome to [get in
touch](mailto:diogo.provete@ufms.br) about other opportunities or to check
back in the future.
